## Description

Estimates likely additions/deletions or rebalance trades and positions around predictable forced flows from index-tracking portfolios.

## Where it may fit

Scheduled index changes and rebalances with predictable inclusion rules and meaningful passive assets tracking the benchmark.

## Vehicles

Event-driven, equity long-short and index-arbitrage funds.

## Required data

Index methodology, point-in-time constituents and eligibility variables, announcement/effective dates, liquidity and passive assets tracking the index.

## Caveats

Crowding, anticipatory trading and methodology changes may erase the edge; use only published information available at the simulated time.
